notes: Account summary: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Heavy product-event ingestion, uses embeddings for feature discovery and personalized in-app suggestions.
Initial approach: started on Hosted API to validate embeddings quality and cost profile; moving toward Dedicated (VPC) for predictable throughput + data isolation.
POC scope: ingest ~5M product events (sanitized), compute embeddings for search & rerank, run support-agent prototype on chat + retrieval-augmented responses.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 < 120ms for single-turn queries (embeddings cache + rerank), steady-state QPS target 120 qps with spikes to 400 qps.

Cost sensitivity: finance wants modeled ARR to be < $150k/year for committed plan; acceptable per-req cost targets set during POC: equivalent < $0.0006/token for generation flows and <$0.0008 per embedding call aggregated.

Security asks (priority): SOC2 Type II evidence for Dedicated, SSO/SAML integration guide, audit log retention policy (1 year minimum), KMS/HSM key wrapping and rotation details, data residency assertions for NA/EU.
Quote from CISO: 'We need to see end-to-end auditability and key custody before granting production access.'

Demo notes: Dedicated demo (2/22) showed throughput estimates; client requested VPC peering diagram and egress accounting. SE called out fallback routing to smaller models during capacity constraints.
Technical concerns: KV cache persistence across pod restarts, model-quantization impact on embedding drift, and how rollouts/ab-tests handled in Dedicated.
Requested artifacts: SOC2 packet, SAML metadata sample, retention controls doc, sample audit log schema, Network/VPC topology example, Dedicated SOW draft.
Procurement: procurement team looped in 3/09; CFO wants a committed tier + overage cap. Wants SOW + invoice schedule for internal approval.
Internal AE notes: good fit for Redwood Optimize later (batching + quantization recommendations). Potential upsell to Private with HSM if KMS requirements tighten.
